summary: A Claude seat on any account has its conversation shown: st reads the transcript path Claude gave the SessionStart hook, and also searches declared accounts' login directories, instead of looking only under ~/.claude

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: Published schema, operations and contract digest are unchanged. The session binding file gains an optional transcript_path field.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change. A recorded path counts only if it is absolute, names this session's file, and is a regular file, not a link.

compatibility.detail: An older daemon ignores the new optional transcript_path field. A newer daemon reads older bindings that lack it and finds a seat on a declared account through that account's login directory. A seat already running on an undeclared account whose binding has no path shows its conversation again after its next restart.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work. The extra account search runs only when the usual places miss.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
